settings.title: A New Orleans personal injury lawyer who still sits on the porch.

settings.editor: Gower Legal is Jacob Gower's boutique on Pine Street in Uptown - call a neighbor, not a billboard.
When a hurricane hits the Gulf, this band comes on so you do not have to hunt. Jacob handles storm and hurricane property claims across Southern Louisiana.
